purpose: Documentation backlog for implementing regression protection; entries are not executable fixtures or passing test results.
profile_policy: Fixtures must name an explicit synthetic, source-pinned reference, or measured product/build profile. Retail captures remain Retail evidence and are kept separate from WF data. Add a WF profile only with named build evidence; passing offline or Retail tests never establishes WF runtime compatibility.
admission_policy: All scenarios begin planned. Register actual tests/fixtures and required CI execution as each mechanic is implemented. Importer scenarios require the future importer; client validation remains separate.

scenarios.title: Lifecycle and load order
scenarios.input_summary: Load the production manifest, deliver another addon's load notification, then our load/login and world-entry notifications.
scenarios.required_result: Initialize once at the documented boundary; preserve restored history, establish one runtime session, and avoid premature collector reads.

scenarios.title: Profile-specific quest acceptance
scenarios.input_summary: Replay the pinned R one-argument and T two-argument QUEST_ACCEPTED signatures in separate reference profiles; also select an unknown profile.
scenarios.required_result: Read the correct quest ID for each selected profile; do not guess an adapter for unknown WF identity or call actions.

scenarios.title: Existing quests and partial enumeration
scenarios.input_summary: Start with active quests; deliver collapsed, filtered, incomplete, and then complete quest-log snapshots.
scenarios.required_result: Create observed baselines without invented acceptances; absence in an incomplete scan does not prove removal or abandonment.

scenarios.title: Objective progress and coalescing
scenarios.input_summary: Advance comparable counts 0 to 1 to 3, repeat unchanged snapshots, and vary legal notification coalescing.
scenarios.required_result: Record supported progress without duplicate unchanged snapshots, invented individual kills, or invented killer attribution.

scenarios.title: Quest removal, repeat runs, and layout changes
scenarios.input_summary: Remove/reaccept a quest and separately replace or reorder its objective layout.
scenarios.required_result: Keep runs and layout generations separate; never subtract incompatible counters or treat every removal as abandonment.

scenarios.title: Reward panel, cancellation, and turn-in
scenarios.input_summary: Open/cancel/reopen reward dialogue, then deliver a real turn-in and removal in supported order variants.
scenarios.required_result: Only the turn-in notification establishes turn-in; dialogue closure alone does not; preserve one turn-in for that occurrence.

scenarios.title: Manual loot, auto-loot, and repeated notifications
scenarios.input_summary: Expose slots before clearing, deliver repeated ready/open/update notifications, then close and begin a distinct interaction.
scenarios.required_result: Capture readable contents before loss, deduplicate only equivalent notifications within their interaction, and retain distinct occurrences.

scenarios.title: Reopened loot and failed collection
scenarios.input_summary: Reopen a source with remaining items; simulate full bags and a visible slot that was not collected.
scenarios.required_result: Preserve visibility without inventing an additional kill or receipt; keep interaction identity explicit.

scenarios.title: Area loot and unavailable source attribution
scenarios.input_summary: Supply verified-profile multi-source tuples, then unsupported or unreadable source results and money/currency/container slots.
scenarios.required_result: Preserve known quantities and source kinds; retain unknown attribution when unavailable; never substitute last target for loot source.

scenarios.title: Inventory moves and unrelated gains
scenarios.input_summary: Move stacks between bags, merge/split stacks, and separately simulate reward/trade gains.
scenarios.required_result: A move is not a new acquisition; inventory gains are not automatically attributed to a nearby monster.

scenarios.title: Nested input aliasing
scenarios.input_summary: Queue or accept an observation, mutate its nested source tables before deferred commit, then reuse the same API/work buffer for another event.
scenarios.required_result: Both queued and committed accepted observations retain their captured values; later observations see their own new values.

scenarios.title: Consumer and exporter mutation
scenarios.input_summary: Read observations through supported consumer interfaces, mutate returned nested data, and construct repeated exports.
scenarios.required_result: The store and prior observations remain unchanged; consumers cannot alter retained history through shared references.

scenarios.title: Unit token reuse and restricted combat
scenarios.input_summary: Replace a target/nameplate token's GUID, remove the token, deny combat registration, and return unreadable fields.
scenarios.required_result: Discard stale entity associations; disappearance is not death; denied combat collection stays unavailable while healthy collectors continue.

scenarios.title: Late, duplicate, failed, and reordered metadata
scenarios.input_summary: Delay metadata across unrelated events, respond out of order, repeat callbacks, fail requests, and return a mismatched content ID.
scenarios.required_result: Append bounded enrichment only for the matching identity/context; preserve original time/location/data and record unresolved results accurately.

scenarios.title: World transitions and position boundaries
scenarios.input_summary: Change maps/instances between samples, make position unavailable, and supply valid boundary coordinates including zero.
scenarios.required_result: Use the current observer/map/time context; never reuse stale coordinates or treat zero as missing or player position as creature position.

scenarios.title: Missing values, tuple arity, and localized text
scenarios.input_summary: Supply return tuples with nil gaps/trailing nil, false, zero, empty values, UTF-8 text, markup, quotes, and line breaks.
scenarios.required_result: Keep argument positions and declared missing-data distinctions; preserve supported text through export without locale-dependent identity.

scenarios.title: Unsupported record values and readability boundary
scenarios.input_summary: Supply cycles, metatables, functions, userdata, nonfinite numbers, unsupported keys, and an opaque unreadable test sentinel.
scenarios.required_result: Reject or omit according to the explicit field/record contract without persisting or formatting unreadable values; existing history remains intact.

scenarios.title: In-memory commit fault boundaries
scenarios.input_summary: Inject catchable faults before validation/copy/append and after append before acknowledgment; retry the same internal submission.
scenarios.required_result: Keep a complete unchanged history prefix; determine committed versus uncommitted outcome, with one effect per retried submission and no partial record.

scenarios.title: Collector error isolation
scenarios.input_summary: Fail one collector/API response while delivering independent valid events; repeat failures with a bounded diagnostic budget.
scenarios.required_result: Healthy collectors continue; prior observations remain intact; errors are visible without recursive logging or unbounded growth.

scenarios.title: Capacity and event storms
scenarios.input_summary: Use tiny record/byte/queue/retry limits, large text, repeated events, full diagnostics capacity, and subsequent resume.
scenarios.required_result: Stay within declared budgets, preserve retained history, report coverage loss without needing main-log space, and reset affected baselines on resume.

scenarios.title: Save, restore, and pre-save termination
scenarios.input_summary: Snapshot a simulated client save, append an unsaved suffix, discard the runtime, and restore only the saved snapshot; also test a normal second save.
scenarios.required_result: Recover the saved prefix exactly; do not claim unsaved records survived; establish a distinct new runtime without duplicating saved observations.

scenarios.title: Reload with pending metadata
scenarios.input_summary: Save unresolved records, restart, requeue allowed requests, and deliver stale-generation callbacks plus a fresh matching result.
scenarios.required_result: Keep original record references; ignore stale callbacks; bound retries and append only valid enrichment under the new runtime generation.

scenarios.title: Supported schema migration chains
scenarios.input_summary: Load independently defined supported old-version fixtures, migrate through required stages, and repeat the operation.
scenarios.required_result: Preserve semantic content/references, validate before promotion, retain a recoverable original, and make repeat migration harmless.

scenarios.title: Migration failure and unknown newer data
scenarios.input_summary: Inject faults at each migration stage; load unknown future schemas and malformed/truncated/oversized data.
scenarios.required_result: Do not silently reset or overwrite input; report an explicit outcome and preserve the recoverable source within defined recovery limits.

scenarios.title: Independent serialization and concurrent export
scenarios.input_summary: Export a selected batch while subsequent capture proceeds; independently parse and compare every field against authored expectations.
scenarios.required_result: Keep stable batch membership/content, preserve array order/types/references/missing reasons, and catch omitted fields even if writer and reader share a bug.

scenarios.title: Chunk completeness and integrity
scenarios.input_summary: Present complete, missing, repeated, reordered, mismatched, corrupt, and oversized export chunks.
scenarios.required_result: Validate the declared chunk protocol; do not acknowledge incomplete or conflicting data as a complete export or clear local history.

scenarios.title: Importer retries and identity conflicts
scenarios.input_summary: When an importer exists, reimport identical observations, alter content under an existing identity, interrupt batches, and send enrichments before referenced records.
scenarios.required_result: Identical data is idempotent, changed content is an explicit conflict, recovery follows declared batch policy, and reference handling is defined.

scenarios.title: Schema parser and data-only import
scenarios.input_summary: When an importer exists, submit invalid versions/types/keys/depth/lengths and text resembling executable Lua or HTML.
scenarios.required_result: Reject invalid data without execution; preserve valid text as data; leave previously imported observations unchanged.

scenarios.title: Determinism, clocks, and session collisions
scenarios.input_summary: Repeat identical seeds/traces, advance wall and monotonic clocks independently, use equal timestamps, and force an ID-provider collision.
scenarios.required_result: Reproduce identical outputs under identical controls; preserve distinct occurrence identity and monotonic sequence; reject or resolve collisions without overwriting history.

scenarios.title: Missing tests and swallowed failures
scenarios.input_summary: Remove a required fixture, skip a suite, discover zero tests, swallow an assertion/process failure, and leave required fake calls unconsumed.
scenarios.required_result: The runner and aggregate gate fail with the missing obligation; no required mechanic is reported protected without executed evidence.

scenarios.title: Controlled implementation mutations
scenarios.input_summary: In isolated harness variants, remove a nested copy, swap a payload argument, mutate history during enrichment, or omit an exported field.
scenarios.required_result: Each variant produces its intended semantic assertion failure; the ordinary implementation passes; broken variants never enter the addon package.

scenarios.title: Package independence and dependency errors
scenarios.input_summary: Load the actual release manifest in order under the controlled host; inspect the artifact and test missing dependencies/case-sensitive paths.
scenarios.required_result: Bootstrap exercises production files, fails clearly for broken dependencies, and excludes fixture runners, development stubs, and enabled fault hooks.

scenarios.title: Profession and gathering evidence
scenarios.input_summary: View/learn a recipe, begin/interrupt/complete candidate crafts, queue attempts, and loot adjacent gathering or skinning sources.
scenarios.required_result: Keep catalog metadata, attempts, successful results, and loot evidence distinct; unknown recipe/source association remains unknown.

scenarios.title: Gossip, vendor offers, and refreshes
scenarios.input_summary: Refresh/continue/close dialogue and vendor listings, change the interacting unit, and present stock/cost updates.
scenarios.required_result: Record shown options and offers with current interaction identity; do not invent selections, purchases, or relationships across stale contexts.
